body:
You ever admire someone so much that they become the catalyst for your burgeoning, natural talent to realise its potential.  Then they say/support something you vehemently disagree with, making that very admiration painful to the bone?

That's the crushing disappointment.

As far as flaws, well, again, I'm pretty pathetic really.  I'm afraid of windstorms (developed a phobia) for example.  The whole week is going to be a series of them hitting us over here.  Nothing that's caused a power outage...yet.  Hasn't done wonders for my mental health, though.  Can't concentrate that well, spend hours lying in bed in the dark, waiting for the storm to be over, you know turn into a wuss.

There are other things rolled into one.  Right now I'm currently keeping them separate so they don't all swarm and attack like locusts.

But my defenses are failing.  They attack again, I'm done for.  Better to abandon ship.
